name: metal_pairs_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Indian metal stocks (Tata Steel, JSW Steel, Hindalco, Vedanta, SAIL) are driven by a combination of global commodity prices (LME steel/aluminium, iron ore) and domestic demand. The intraday correlation (0.60-0.75) is among the highest in any Indian sector because: (1) LME prices move in Asian morning creating a common opening signal, (2) China demand/supply data affects all metals simultaneously, (3) government trade policy (import duties, export incentives) applies sector-wide. The pairs opportunity arises from the DOMESTIC vs GLOBAL divide: Tata Steel and JSW Steel have significant global operations (Tata Steel Europe, JSW US) while SAIL is purely domestic. When global metal prices move sharply (LME steel ±2%), Tata Steel and JSW react more strongly than SAIL, creating a temporary divergence that partially reverts as the market realizes domestic demand fundamentals are unchanged.
universe: Tata Steel, JSW Steel, Hindalco, Vedanta, SAIL, NMDC
stock_filter: Tata Steel: ADV > ₹200 crore. JSW: ADV > ₹100 crore. Others: ADV > ₹40 crore

indicators.name: metal_group_return
indicators.formula: equal_weighted_mean(cum_return of Tata Steel, JSW, Hindalco, Vedanta, SAIL, NMDC)

indicators.name: global_metal_signal
indicators.formula: sign of overnight LME steel HRC and LME aluminium % change

conditions: spread_zscore > 2.0 (global-focused stocks overperforming domestic — expect SAIL/NMDC catch-up or Tata/JSW pullback)
NIFTY Metal index trending (sector is active)
spread_zscore < -2.0 (domestic stocks outperforming global — expect convergence)

entry.entry_price: market order on both legs: long laggard sub-group + short leader sub-group

exit.signal_exit: LME prices continue moving strongly during Indian trading hours (sustained global pressure)

risk.position_sizing: ₹50K per sub-group leg (₹25K per stock in each sub-group)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 25 (metal stocks are high-beta, volatile in high VIX)
filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.trend_filter: trade is contrarian on the spread (fade divergence, not chase it)
filters.event_filter: skip on China PMI day, India trade policy announcement day (all metals move directionally)
other_filters: skip if iron ore moved > 3% overnight (NMDC is pure iron ore play, separate dynamics)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — the domestic vs global metal stock divide is structural. Tata Steel Europe and JSW US operations ensure different sensitivities to global prices. SAIL's purely domestic focus is also permanent.

weaknesses: Vedanta is a diversified miner (zinc, aluminium, oil), not a pure metal play. Its inclusion in the group distorts the group return calculation.
LME prices are not available real-time on Zerodha. Requires separate data subscription for LME live prices, adding cost and complexity.
Metal stocks are high-beta and volatile — the 15 bps stop on each leg may be too tight, causing frequent stop-outs in normal intraday volatility.
prior_art: Pairs trading literature (Gatev et al. 2006). In India, NIFTY Metal index has been studied for commodity price pass-through. World Steel Association data on India's domestic vs export steel production. Tata Steel annual report on European operations.
notes: LME trading hours overlap with Indian market hours (afternoon in LME Asian session). Real-time LME price changes during 09:00-14:00 IST can trigger fresh divergences. Consider NMDC (iron ore miner) separately from steel producers — its correlation is with iron ore, not steel prices.
